'''West Mahea''' is a sub-continent located in the southern hemisphere. It is bordered the [[Ubrana Sea]] and [[South Mahea]] to the south. [[North Mahea]] to the west, [[South Ayuma]] to the north, and the [[Kera Sea]] to the east. The continent covers around {{convert|3,615,572|km2|sqmi|abbr=on}} of land, making it the 16th largest sub-continent in the world, with a total of about 146,859,371 as of 1765, making it also the 17th largest sub-continent by population.
